instruction: Read only the public problem and document. Recover the distinct reasoning steps actually advocated, in your own concise ordinary English. Separate distinct causal applications, merge duplicates, and abstain on unsupported or unresolved ones. Return any number of steps. For each give premise, action, consequence, and quote (one exact contiguous source passage supporting the step). Use [] if none. No fixed vocabulary or reference answers are supplied.
